disease_state.evidence: In a proteomic MS approach, we wanted now to investigate these synovial fluids for novel proteogenic markers of periprosthetic infections.
In 21 patients undergoing revision arthroplasty due to septic or aseptic implant loosening, synovial fluid was collected intraoperatively after opening the joint capsule.
